ops-bot: info: traffic rebalanced across na-east-1 and na-west-1; autoscaler reported 0 anomalies
Lina Gomez: huge thanks to infra + release crew — tagging @Theo @Riley — will drop a kudos thread in #general tomorrow. :heart:
PeopleOps: noted. ordering a small celebratory cake for 09:00 tomorrow and gluten-free cookies.
Theo Kim: throwback: remember the pre-launch yak-shave? feels like ages. time for a tiny team trophy? :trophy:
Riley Watts: photo incoming. roof is twinkle-lit, tacos stacked, one inflatable palm tree. :palm_tree: :camera_with_flash:
Lina Gomez: love it. quick 10-min post-launch retro after stand tomorrow to capture wins and any followups. enjoy the tacos! :tada:
